_doc: host / port: where `dsh web` listens. Use 127.0.0.1 for local-only access, or a concrete local interface IP (for example a VMware NAT host IP) when a VM must reach it. `dsh web` rejects wildcard addresses.
package: the package spec passed to npx. `@latest` resolves the latest release on every start; pin a version for reproducible starts.
cwd: working directory for the `dsh web` process (the default workspace for new sessions). `~` is expanded.
session: tmux session name managed by this script.
npxPath: optional absolute path to npx; leave empty to resolve from PATH.
shortHost / shortPort: the token-free short link. Empty shortHost follows host. The short link 302s to the current token URL.
extraArgs: extra arguments appended to the `dsh web` command.
startTimeoutMs / stopTimeoutMs: startup and shutdown wait limits in milliseconds.
